query:
-- Faturamento acumulado Morumbi dias 1-15 de maio/2026
SELECT 
  SUM(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8+cat9) as totalRealizado,
  COUNT(*) as diasLancados
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-morumbi' 
  AND data BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-15';
